dedupe_keys.name: fibo financial industry business ontology edm council

description: FIBO, the Financial Industry Business Ontology, is an ontology in the W3C Web Ontology Language (OWL) that defines the things of interest in financial business applications and how they relate, so that spreadsheets, databases and messages about financial instruments, parties, contracts and markets can be given one unambiguous meaning. The EDM Council FIBO page says it is hosted and sponsored by the EDM Council, standardised by the Object Management Group, reviewed by member firms and, since January 2020, developed by an open community process with the GitHub repository as the main platform; it is published in several formats with a FIBO Viewer and a data model (FIBO-DM). The GitHub licence file reads MIT (copyright 2020 EDM Council), so the ontology files are free to use; the FAIRsharing registry also lists FIBO (record DOI 10.25504/FAIRsharing.de5cd6). Coverage is financial services worldwide. Caveats: FIBO is a vocabulary, not data about payment or market infrastructure, the release cadence is not stated on the pages read, and some products around it are for EDM Council members. For simulation it gives a shared schema to join data on banks, payment systems and contracts when modelling how operational failures spread through the financial system. Related catalogue records include the Carnegie cyber incidents in financial institutions and the BIS CPMI Red Book payment statistics.
